title: Darkness Absolute
narrativeText: They say the ring explodes at the end of a Barbwire Deathmatch. When Daemon is involved, the darkness claims the explosion first. The crowd cannot see what happens in those final moments. Only the result matters — and Daemon is still standing.

choices.label: Claim the Darkness
choices.text: The ring, the barbwire, the explosions — all of it belongs to the dark.
